database: Local Supabase Postgres (container supabase_db_PEAK3, postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:54422/postgres) — the API logs 'Repository registry: postgres (20/20 domains)'. The hosted project in apps/api/.env was NOT used: its password is stale and it produces only asyncpg errors.
web: Production build (next build + next start) for every frame except the head-to-head ones, which need the e2e test-auth channel that auth-context.tsx removes under NODE_ENV=production and are therefore captured against the dev server. Every frame records which in `server`.
note: Signed-in frames use the e2e test-auth channel: Google is not enabled on the development Supabase project and no mailbox is reachable from this environment, so no live provider round-trip could be captured.
